releaseNotes: Added PocketFlix v1.1.0 features multi-source scraping (VegaMovies/RogMovies),an interactive selection modal with an Auto fallback button (vidsrc.sbs), an embedded WebView player with ad-blocking and touch controls, a 10-second shake easter egg greeting from developer Om Gondhankhede (aka vinayak_builder), and an automated GitHub workflow for version updates.
